entries.original: **`oh-my-openagent@5.0.0-beta.43` died at `npm run sync:skills`** because the published tarball did not carry `packages/prompts-core/prompts/ultrawork/codex.md`, the canonical ultrawork directive the Codex cache install reads. The root `files` allowlist now ships it (#7835, thanks @LilMGenius) and the pre-publish payload verifier refuses a payload without it (#7836).

The root `files` allowlist now ships it (#7835, thanks @LilMGenius) and the pre-publish payload verifier refuses a payload without it (#7836).

entries.original: **`lazycodex-ai@5.0.0-beta.43` died at the same step** because the curated lazycodex `files` list lacked `packages/shared-skills/skill-source-filter.mjs`. The list is fixed and the verifier now requires every shared-skills runtime export target (#7813).

entries.original: **Both packages would have failed again on dev** — the shared-skills imports in `sync-skills.mjs` had been changed (#7814) to checkout-relative paths that do not exist once the installer flattens `plugin/` into `<CODEX_HOME>/plugins/cache/<marketplace>/omo/<version>`. Restored to the package specifier the installer's `file:` link resolves, with a regression test that runs sync-skills inside a reproduction of that cache layout (#7848).

entries.original: **The `skipped OMO SOT seed/migration` warning is gone**: the installer no longer spawns a migration script that was removed from the payload (#7837).

entries.original: The published-package smoke job actually installs both payloads through `installMarketplaceLocally` instead of dry-running (#7839).

entries.original: The payload verifier reads both npm 11 and npm 12 `npm pack --json` shapes (#7840) and spawns npm through a shell on Windows so the gate can run locally there (#7844).
